correctness.rationale: For arbitrary dimension and bias, convex averaging over target-preserving cube automorphisms reduces any feasible chain to three parameters; Walsh Fourier characters give all spectral blocks. Exact Loewner sandwich and a Cauchy/determinant obstruction yield a quadratic lower bound; strict derivative sign excludes a larger vertical flow at smaller mu. The explicit nonnegative detailed-balance kernel saturates the bound and the uniform endpoint is consistent with the known result. The standalone symbolic/numerical verifier completed 883 checks; finite checks are supporting, not proofs of universality.

value.rationale: The natural full-support product-target hypercube family is motivated by nearest-neighbor sampling of one exceptional Bernoulli variable and d fair variables. It yields a complete exact globally optimal SLEM and explicit transition rule, with strict improvement for every bias and a sharp limit agreeing with the lower-dimensional cube. The state-dependent fair-coordinate move rates reveal a nontrivial structural feature absent in uniform-coordinate random scans. This is not merely a restatement of an eigenvalue computation or an unmotivated finite slice.
